_comment: Fitness creator on Pro tier. 4 items cleared the relevance threshold this morning.

items.headline: Instagram Subscriptions opens to all creators ≥10K followers
items.relevanceToCreator: You're on IG and over 10K — this unlocks paid subscriber tiers as a new revenue line.

items.headline: Survey: 38% of CMOs shifting fitness/wellness influencer budgets to long-form video
items.relevanceToCreator: Brand-deal market is moving toward longer formats in your exact niche; expect fewer Reels deals, more YouTube + IGTV asks.

items.headline: TikTok rolls out 90-second Reels-style retention scoring
items.relevanceToCreator: Your TikTok performance metrics will start including a 90s-retention column; relevant if you're cutting >60s clips.

items.headline: FTC updates influencer disclosure guidance — supplement category specifically
items.relevanceToCreator: Fitness creators who do supplement deals: stricter #ad and verbal-disclosure rules. Worth reviewing your last 3 sponsored posts for compliance.

output.summary: Two big platform shifts (IG Subscriptions opening + TikTok 90s retention rollout), a market-budget shift toward long-form, and a tightened FTC posture on supplement disclosures. Action items: turn on IG Subscriptions, audit recent supplement deals.
